# Author, institute, palette, and the Beamer preamble come from _quarto.yml.
# To override the author list, use a structured array — a scalar `author: "Name"` is
# APPENDED to the _quarto.yml authors, not substituted:
# author:
#   - name: "[Name]"
format:
  beamer:
    keep-tex: false
  revealjs:                     # same source, HTML deck: quarto render <file>.qmd --to revealjs
    theme: [default, ../preambles/revealjs/slides.scss]       # Beamer palette in SCSS

    institute: ""               # avoid a duplicate affiliation line on the title slide
# Render one format at a time: --to beamer / --to revealjs. Keep Beamer-only LaTeX (\pause,
# columns environments) inside ::: {.content-visible when-format="beamer"} blocks.
# Talk chunks with cache: true serve stale table labels after setFixest_dict changes —
# render with --cache-refresh. Images live at ../../images/ relative to paper/talks/.
bibliography: ../../references.bib
